question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Start with top-level containers
    SELECT packaging_id as root_id, contains_id as current_id, qty as current_qty, 1 as depth, qty as accumulated_qty
    FROM packaging_relations
    WHERE packaging_id IN (SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations))
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursively find children and accumulate the product
    SELECT h.root_id, pr.contains_id as current_id, pr.qty as current_qty, h.depth + 1, h.accumulated_qty * pr.qty
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT p1.name as container_name, p2.name as item_name, SUM(h.accumulated_qty) as total_qty
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging p1 ON h.root_id = p1.id
JOIN packaging p2 ON h.current_id = p2.id
WHERE h.current_id IN (501, 502)
GROUP BY p1.name, p2.name
ORDER BY p1.name, p2.name
